# awscc_pi_perf_reports (Data Source)

Data Source schema for AWS::PI::PerfReports



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `analysis_report_id` (String) A unique identifier for the analysis report.
- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the performance analysis report.
- `create_time` (String) The time the analysis report was created in ISO 8601 format.
- `end_time` (String) The end time defined for the analysis report in ISO 8601 format.
- `identifier` (String) An immutable, AWS Region-unique identifier for a data source. Performance Insights gathers metrics from this data source. To use an Amazon RDS instance as a data source, specify its DbiResourceId value.
- `service_type` (String) The AWS service for which Performance Insights returns metrics. Valid values are RDS and DOCDB.
- `start_time` (String) The start time defined for the analysis report in ISO 8601 format.
- `status` (String) The status of the analysis report.
- `tags` (Attributes Set) An array of key-value pairs to apply to this resource. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Read-Only:

- `key` (String) The key name of the tag.
- `value` (String) The value for the tag.
